limitations: Identity-agnostic localization: an optimistic upper bound, NOT proof of correct anatomical or temporal identity. No independent identity accuracy is estimated; per-frame assignments may switch freely.
Dog02 is exploratory, not an independent confirmatory evaluation.
Existing human labels may have been model-exposed; exposure counts are reported.

policies.assignment: Per-frame maximum-cardinality one-to-one minimum total Euclidean distance; deterministic input-order ties; no threshold-based rematching
policies.denominator: All visible merged human A/B labels, identical for both methods; absent predictions are misses
policies.rawRTMPose: Successful detection, saved finite hind-paw coordinates, no score or image-bound filtering
policies.trackerRecovery: Existing defaults; associated non-null points from accepted recovery segments only; unresolved/rejected/absent frames are misses
policies.predictionAvailability: One-to-one assigned visible labels / all visible labels, regardless of distance
policies.wholeVideoCoverage: Available paw points / (2 * all saved video frames), including unannotated frames
